front.title: Acceptor Source Binding for Bundle Protocol Security (BPSec)

abstract.t: RFC 9172 Section 8.2.2 describes how a legitimate node can replace a source's Block Integrity Block (BIB) with one made under its own key, and how an acceptor that only checks that a BIB "was generated by a legitimate user" accepts the result. This document specifies the acceptor-side condition that prevents this substitution in deployments with per-source keys: each required security service on a target block is bound to the security source that is authoritative for that block, and is not satisfied by a block from any other source, even an authorized one. It also clarifies that the primary block is bound to a payload only through the integrity scope of the payload's own BIB, not through a separate BIB over the primary block.
